newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean business group visits North Korea.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean business group visits North Korea.

text.p: The first South Koreans to visit North Korea since a submarine incursion froze contacts between the two countries last September arrived on Tuesday, a unification ministry spokesman said.
The spokesman told reporters that Park Choon, managing director of Daewoo Corp, and three Daewoo technicians arrived in the Stalinist state via Beijing.
"It is another indication that both countries are cautiously expanding contacts," a ministry official told Reuters.

Despite heightening tensions after a senior North Korean official sought asylum in Seoul's consular office in Beijing, the two countries have taken steps that could help promote a thaw in relations, he added.

Twenty six officials from state-run Korea Electric Power Corp are due to visit North Korea on Saturday to prepare for the construction of nuclear power plants in the communist state, a foreign ministry official said.

Pyongyang announced last Friday that it would attend a preliminary briefing in New York on March 5 on Korean peninsula peace talks proposed by the United States and South Korea, which would also include China.
